entities.summary: Mark Benedict Coleridge is an Australian Catholic prelate who was Metropolitan Archbishop of Brisbane from 2012 to 2025. He was previously Archbishop of Canberra–Goulburn (2006–2012) and as an auxiliary bishop of the Metropolitan Archdiocese of Melbourne (2002–2006).
